text:
maya: Quick precut sanity check — we plan to cut in ~4h. Drop thumbs if you own an item below and will finish before cutoff.

maya: checklist: 1) minor version bump + changelog entry 2) docs frontpage update 3) QA smoke + canary 4) security quick-review 5) branch freeze (no non-blocking merges)

samir: taking the version bump + changelog. I'll do `npm version minor` on the release branch and open PR with changelog. ETA ~45m.

natalie: security side — I'll run the quick SCA scan and a dependency diff, should be done in ~1h. ping me if anything new lands.

ashley: I'll coordinate docs. small copy tweak on console guide and add the new route docs. pushing a doc PR in 30.

qa_jordan: starting smoke runs now against the rc branch. Early failure: auth integration flake on /v1/generate-metrics, investigating.

samir: @qa_jordan can you paste the failing log? also rebased my bump branch onto rc to avoid merge conflicts.

qa_jordan: failing log snippet: `AssertionError: expected 200 but got 502` on request id 0x8f3c. Looks like a transient gateway issue, rerunning.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for rc-2026-03-17 by samir — 3/5 nodes healthy, traffic ramping.

maya: if auth flake persists we should hold cut. @natalie any red flags from security?

natalie: SCA passed, no new high CVEs. Noted one medium with transitive dependency — I've flagged mitigation steps in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REL-3221. No blocker for release.

qa_jordan: rerun passed, all smoke tests green except one timing-sensitive test which I marked flaky and skipped for this run. Full regression queued — should finish within 2h.

samir: PR ready: 2499-version-bump -> rc (includes changelog entry). Bump note: 0.23.7 -> 0.24.0, highlights: improved batching heuristics, bugfix: kv-cache eviction.

maya: great. small ask — add a one-line note in the changelog about kv-cache behavior so infra teams know.

ashley: added doc note and linked changelog in the PR description.

natalie: quick reminder: update SBOM artifact after the final merge. I'll re-run SCA after that and sign off.

samir: merging in 10m unless objections.

maya: thumbs from owners: @samir (version), @ashley (docs), @natalie (security), @qa_jordan (qa)

qa_jordan: :thumbsup: smoke clean, regression still running but low risk.

natalie: :white_check_mark: will recheck SBOM post-merge.

ashley: :thumbsup: docs in, minor formatting note addressed.

deploy-bot: Release cut completed for rc-2026-03-17 by samir — tag v0.24.0 created, artifacts uploaded.

maya: thanks team — I'll publish the internal release note and open the rollout window. If regression finishes cleanly we'll promote canary in 1h.

samir: leaving a final reminder in the changelog PR: `DO NOT SQUASH` to preserve commit authorship for release notes.

maya: closing thread — ping me if anything blocks. :party:
